verdict.rationale: Floot's docs show some control over your own data: you can download a full SQL dump or backup of the managed Postgres database at any time, export the code and database to self-host, and run writes through execute_sql, which could cover deleting rows in the app database. Nothing addresses retention policies or deleting projects, accounts or Floot-held data, so only a fraction of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented retention periods or retention controls, project/account deletion and data purge guarantees, deletion of logs and chat/AI history, and independent corroboration.
